payload.rationale: A deliberately simple starting distribution for unrounded monthly headline CPI: normal mean0.20 percentage points and SD0.15 percentage points. Both parameters are subjective macro assumptions, not fitted data. Published single-decimal change must exceed0.2, approximated by unrounded change>=0.25. Broad macro context from the prior Fed example was already present; this is not a fresh-context prior.
assumptions: Ordinary BLS release and usual nearest-tenth rounding
No separate probability assigned to shutdown/no-data fallback
uncertainties: Forecast error around a short-run momentum model
